# Dammam OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

Municipality outreach package for **Dammam, Saudi Arabia**. Figures are
screening outputs for discussion, not a bid, endorsement or construction release.

## Audience

- Office of the Mayor or city executive for Dammam
- Dammam municipal transport and urban-planning authority
- Dammam climate, energy or sustainability office
- Dammam municipal finance and investment unit

## Local proposition

| Measure | Current planning result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 1,500,000 |
| Lines / route length | 6 / 272.9 km |
| Line-platform stops / fleet | 97 / 325 trainsets |
| Practical capacity ceiling | 982,080 passenger-trips/day |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 32.9 MW / 179.5 MWh |
| City programme CAPEX | $2.20 B |
| Local capital and value share | $1.68 B (76%) |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $3.44 B |
| Annual OPEX planning value | $80 M |

Lead with locally buildable infrastructure, open design review, renewable-energy
integration and a staged feasibility process. Do not lead with the comparator;
it is an illustrative sensitivity, not a vendor quotation.

## Call to action

Ask for a 30-minute technical review, nomination of a municipal counterpart,
access to current mobility/land/utility data, and agreement on the scope of an
independent feasibility study. Verify the recipient in
[`contact-research.csv`](../../../../contact-research.csv)
before sending.
